name: Seedling
summary: An upload button that plants your file as a seed and grows it into a flower while it uploads
about: Seedling turns an upload into a tiny garden. Pick or drop a file and a seed marked with its real type (read from the file's first bytes) drops into a clay pot, a rain cloud rolls in and the stem and leaves grow with the progress. When the upload ends the flower blooms in a colour that matches the file type, pollen drifts up and a wooden marker shows the file name.
how: Press Plant a file to pick any file, drop one on the pot, or plant a sample.
The seed shows the true file type; empty files or files over 50 MB bounce off the rim with a note.
Rain falls and the stem, leaves and bud grow with the progress shown on the button.
The flower blooms with pollen, then folds back into the soil and the button resets.
